Most sounds in this folder are CC0 (public domain). Two are not: pickup.wav is
CC BY-NC 4.0, and healer_attack.wav is CC BY 4.0.

Kenney files were converted to mono 48 kHz WAV and level-matched. Music is
64 kbps Opus. The Freesound notes below say what else was changed.

Kenney (www.kenney.nl), CC0 -- https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
  "Interface Sounds" pack:
    ui_hover.wav      <- select_001.ogg
    ui_confirm.wav    <- confirmation_001.ogg
    ui_click.wav      <- click_001.ogg
    place.wav         <- drop_002.ogg
    place_fail.wav    <- error_006.ogg
    select_units.wav  <- select_004.ogg
    order.wav         <- pluck_001.ogg
    pause.wav         <- minimize_005.ogg
    resume.wav        <- maximize_005.ogg
  "Impact Sounds" pack:
    hit_0..4.wav        <- impactSoft_medium_000..004.ogg
    tree_hit_0..2.wav <- impactWood_light_000..002.ogg
    tree_break.wav    <- impactWood_heavy_000.ogg

OpenGameArt.org, CC0:
  bgm_title.opus      <- "Flowerbed Fields [Loop]" by Zane Little Music
                         https://opengameart.org/content/flowerbed-fields-loop
  bgm_battle.opus     <- "Tower Defense Theme" by DST
                         https://opengameart.org/content/tower-defense-theme
  jingle_victory.opus <- win_1.ogg, "The War Over A Melon Field - Themes and Jingles" by Spring
  jingle_defeat.opus  <- lose_3.ogg, same pack (bicycle horn sound by AntumDeluge)
                         https://opengameart.org/content/the-war-over-a-melon-field-themes-and-jingles

Freesound.org:
  brawler_attack.wav  <- "Whoosh" by qubodup, sound 60013, CC0
                         https://freesound.org/people/qubodup/sounds/60013/
                         https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
                         Converted from the 24-bit stereo FLAC to 16-bit stereo WAV.
  ranged_attack.wav   <- "bullet ricochet.wav" by aust_paul, sound 30932, CC0
                         https://freesound.org/people/aust_paul/sounds/30932/
                         https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
                         First of the four ricochets in that file (0.20 s), with a
                         12 ms fade at the end.
  pickup.wav          <- "Drip1.wav" by acclivity, sound 25879
                         CC BY-NC 4.0: attribution required, non-commercial use only
                         https://freesound.org/people/acclivity/sounds/25879/
                         https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc/4.0/
                         Credit: "Drip1.wav" by acclivity of freesound.org
                         Used as uploaded.
  healer_attack.wav   <- "Magic Healing Spell SFX - Fantasy RPG Restore Effect"
                         by TommasoMotteran, sound 853303, CC BY 4.0
                         https://freesound.org/people/TommasoMotteran/sounds/853303/
                         https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
                         Credit: Coghezzi - Freesound.org
                         Sped to 2x (1.25 s) and converted from 24-bit to 16-bit stereo.
